subject: Data path validation for new Edge Connector
messages:
From: Sabrina Cole <sabrina@edgeconnect.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@edgeconnect.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Data path validation for EdgeSync connector

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As a next step our PM asked for a short confirmation of Redwood's subprocessors and the expected cross-border flows for the new EdgeSync connector (EdgeConnect will be transferring webhook payloads from EU customers to a processing tier in the US for enrichment).

Can you send a current subprocessor roster for any components that will touch payloads (ingest, enrichment, logging, analytics) and a simple data-path diagram showing where data may cross borders? We're also trying to confirm whether any of your subprocessors are located in jurisdictions requiring specific SCC/transfer documentation.

Preferably by EOD tomorrow so our legal team can finalize the attachment to our DPA addendum.

Appreciate it,

Sabrina Cole
Partnerships Lead, EdgeConnect

Attachments: none

Sabrina —

Thanks for the clear note. We're pulling together the subprocessor inventory and a high-level flow diagram. To make sure we capture precisely what EdgeSync will do, a couple quick clarifying questions:

- Will EdgeSync include PII inside payloads (names, email addresses) or only metadata + identifiers?
- Which EU region are you primarily onboarding (EU-W, EU-C)? This affects which regional logs/backups may be involved.

Cc'ing Soojin (Security) and Rishi (Privacy) so they can validate the roster and provide required transfer/legal docs (SCC/adequacy references or alternative safeguards).

We'll aim to send a roster + diagram and any relevant transfer references by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data path validation for EdgeSync connector

Hi all,

Quick checklist from security to speed up review — please provide the following and we'll flag anything that requires an SCC or additional controls: 

1) Subprocessor roster (name, country, subprocessor role, contact email)
2) Data-flow diagram (simple bbox diagram: EdgeConnect -> Ingest -> Enrichment -> Analytics -> Log store) with flags on where PII may be persisted or forwarded
3) Retention windows per component (ingest KV cache, enrichment intermediate store, long-term analytics)
4) Whether payloads are encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest for each component
5) Any special opt-out/data-minimisation steps performed before enrichment

If any subprocessors are in territories without an EU adequacy decision, we'll include links to our SCC baseline and, where required, our vendor-assessed supplemental controls (e.g., contractual encryption, restricted personnel access).

I'll review the roster as soon as it's uploaded to the secure drive. If you'd rather not send the roster directly over email, please share a Drive link (restricted) and I will pull it.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
So.jin@redwood.ai

Attachments: security_checklist_template.xlsx (referenced; will upload if helpful)
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sabrina Cole <sabrina@edgeconnect.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@edgeconnect.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data path validation for EdgeSync connector

Sabrina / Marta,

Attached is the current subprocessor roster and a high-level data-path diagram for the planned EdgeSync flow. Summary below:

- Ingest (Redwood Ingest API) — hosted in eu-west (data plane) with failover to us-east for enrichment burst; subprocessor: FastQueue Inc. (Ireland) for queuing; AuditLog+ (US) for long-term logs
- Enrichment (third-party enrichment microservice) — contract with Enrichly (US) — processes payloads for enrichment; only enrichment metadata results returned to EdgeConnect
- Analytics (internal Redwood telemetry) — aggregated metrics stored in EU region where possible; backups to US for disaster recovery

Short answers to your questions:
- Payloads: expected to include PII fields (email, name) as part of enrichment identifiers — please treat as PII.
- Region: primary onboarding is eu-central (Frankfurt).
- TLS is enforced on all transport hops; at-rest encryption applied for persistent stores.

Attachments (stubbed):
- edgeconnect_subprocessors_20280712.csv (CSV) — detailed roster, countries, roles
- edgeflow_sequence_diagram_20280712.pdf (PDF) — simplified data-path diagram

We have also included references to our SCC implementation and standard vendor controls. If Soojin flags anything that requires mitigation (e.g., additional contractual clauses or encryption key control), we'll follow up with a redline to the DPA addendum.

Lauren
Privacy & Trust — Redwood Inference
Lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: edgeconnect_subprocessors_20280712.csv (CSV), edgeflow_sequence_diagram_20280712.pdf (PDF)
